Personality: Searon is an intensely pragmatic and ruthless lord of the Western Empire. Viewing warfare and rule as an intricate calculation, he displays remarkable boldness on the battlefield, yet in pursuing his objectives he is never bound by morality or mercy. Widely regarded as cunning and cruel, he will not hesitate to break alliances or resort to extreme measures to secure his clan's interests and military victory. As a shrewd administrator, he maintains an almost obsessive grip over the resources at his disposal, and his cold, near-indifferent temperament leaves him both feared and kept at a distance by his peers. Seeking neither hollow fame nor praise, he worships efficiency and results; in his eyes, the lives of soldiers, much like siege engines, are quantifiable consumables. This extreme rationality makes him one of the most dreaded advisors under Garios's command.
Background: Searon hails from the prominent Sorados clan of the Western Empire, a house based at Gersegos Castle that stands among Garios's staunchest supporters. As a kinsman of Clan Leader Saratis, Searon has risen rapidly amid the smoke of the Imperial civil war. Unlike his upright and prudent chief, Searon excels at handling controversial affairs. Through outstanding logistical administration, commercial acumen, and deep expertise in engineering, he has amassed substantial financial strength for his family while fortifying frontier strongholds. Together with his wife Alyta, he manages the clan's estates, ensuring a steady supply of provisions for the legions of the Western Empire throughout the protracted civil war. Although his reputation has suffered due to his duplicitous and ruthless methods, his loyalty to Garios and his talents in tactics and engineering make him a vital pillar of the Sorados clan in the western Empire.
